name: Medmis
description: Medmis clinic management platform (Russia): branches, specialists and schedules, appointments, patients, invoices, payments, price list, stock, to-do tasks and occupational check-ups. Booking or changing an appointment and creating a task are included, installed switched off; nothing is deleted.
instructions:
## Medmis
This connector uses the **MEDMIS API v1** (the integration bus of the Medmis clinic management platform, `<your node>/apix/v1`): branches, specialists and their schedules, appointments, patients, invoices, payments, the price list, reserves, stock, to-do tasks and the occupational check-up module (Профосмотры). It reads; booking or changing an appointment and creating a task are included but installed switched off. Nothing is ever deleted through this connector.

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. Ask Medmis support (support@medmis.ru, subject marked DEV / API_CORE) or your Medmis administrator for an **API user**: a login, its password and the **system name** used to sign in. The API user's permissions decide what the tools can read (`appointments.get`, `patients.get`, `patient_invoices.get`, `payments.get`, `schedules.get`, `stores.get`, `todo.tasks.get`, `profex.*`...).
2. `MEDMIS_URL` is the address of your clinic's Medmis node, e.g. `https://node3.medmis.ru`, without `/apix`. Its API reference is at `<MEDMIS_URL>/apix/swagger`.
3. Fill in `MEDMIS_LOGIN`, `MEDMIS_PASSWORD` (at least 6 characters) and `MEDMIS_SYSTEM_NAME`, install, and run `medmis_list_branches` to check.

The connector signs in with `POST /apix/v1/Auth/login` and sends the access token as a Bearer header; tokens live about an hour and are renewed automatically.

**Workflow**
- Start with `medmis_list_branches` and `medmis_list_employees` (ids of branches, specialists and their specializations).
- Free time: `medmis_get_schedule_grid` with branchIds, dateFrom, dateTo and `onlyFreeSlots=true`.
- Appointments: `medmis_list_appointments` for a period (filter by specialist, status, patient), `medmis_get_appointment`, and `medmis_list_appointment_reference` (statuses, types, visitations, sources, tags) to read the ids.
- Patients: `medmis_list_patients` (name, phone, e-mail, card number), `medmis_get_patient` for the full record, `medmis_list_patient_reference` (tags, attractions, identity_doc_types).
- Money: `medmis_list_invoices`, `medmis_get_invoice`, `medmis_list_invoice_services`, `medmis_list_payments`, `medmis_get_payment`.
- Price list: `medmis_list_service_categories`, `medmis_list_services`, and a specialist's offer with `medmis_list_employee_services`.
- Other: `medmis_list_reserves`, `medmis_get_reserve`, `medmis_get_branch`; stock with `medmis_list_stores` (per branch), `medmis_list_store_materials`, `medmis_get_stock_levels`, `medmis_list_material_series`; tasks with `medmis_list_tasks`; check-ups with `medmis_list_checkup_companies`, `medmis_list_checkup_contracts`, `medmis_list_checkup_patients`.

**Writes switched off**: `medmis_create_appointment` (book a slot), `medmis_update_appointment` (move, cancel via status, change comment or tags) and `medmis_create_task`. They change the clinic's live schedule, so an admin turns them on deliberately; before each call show the user the patient, specialist, day and time and wait for a yes.

**Patient data**: patients, appointments, invoices and payments are personal health data. Read only what the question needs and do not repeat identity documents or contact data unless the user asks. The patient list leaves out identity document numbers, INN and SNILS.

**Dates and ids**: day filters are `YYYY-MM-DD`; change-time filters are `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` in UTC. Appointments carry both UTC and local times (`datetimeFromLocal`) plus `utcOffsetMinutes`; quote local times. Branches, specialists, patients, appointments and payments use UUIDs; invoices, stores, materials, tasks and check-up records use numbers. List filters ending in `Ids` take several values.

**Pagination and limits**: lists return `items`, `page`, `pageSize`, `totalCount` and `totalPages`; pageSize is at most 100, page starts at 1. Medmis limits each method: filtered lists 20 requests a minute (one per second), reference lists 40 a minute, single records 100 a minute, sign-in 40 a minute. Avoid tight loops; 429 means wait.

**Errors**: 401 means a wrong login, password or system name, or an expired session (the connector signs in again once). 403 means the API user lacks the permission for that method. 400 `ValidationError` lists the bad fields (e.g. a password shorter than 6 characters, a malformed date). 404 means the id does not exist on your node.
prerequisites: A Medmis clinic account and an API user (login, password and system name) from Medmis support or your administrator, with the permissions for the data you want to read.

MEDMIS_URL.label: Medmis node address
MEDMIS_URL.help: Address of your clinic's Medmis node, without /apix. Medmis support tells you which node your clinic runs on.
MEDMIS_URL.patternMessage: Only the address, e.g. https://node3.medmis.ru, without /apix.

MEDMIS_LOGIN.label: API login
MEDMIS_LOGIN.help: Login of the Medmis API user.

MEDMIS_PASSWORD.label: API password
MEDMIS_PASSWORD.help: Password of the Medmis API user, at least 6 characters.
MEDMIS_PASSWORD.patternMessage: Medmis passwords have at least 6 characters.

MEDMIS_SYSTEM_NAME.label: System name
MEDMIS_SYSTEM_NAME.help: The system name the API user signs in with (systemName in the login request), given with the API user.

verifyHints.401: Medmis refused the sign-in. Check MEDMIS_LOGIN, MEDMIS_PASSWORD and MEDMIS_SYSTEM_NAME with Medmis support.
verifyHints.403: Signed in, but the API user lacks the permission for this method (e.g. branches.get). Ask your Medmis administrator to grant it.
verifyHints.404: Nothing found at this address. MEDMIS_URL must be your node's address without /apix, e.g. https://node3.medmis.ru.
verifyHints.429: Medmis rate limit reached. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: medmis_list_branches
tools.description: List the clinic's branches (филиалы): id, code, name, official name, address, phone, e-mail, working hours, licence and UTC offset. The id is the branchId other tools filter by.

tools.name: medmis_get_branch
tools.description: Get one branch by id with its address, contacts, working hours, licence data and UTC offset.

tools.name: medmis_list_employees
tools.description: List the specialists (doctors and other staff with schedules): id, name, mobile phone, specializations with their ids, branches and whether they are dismissed. Filter by branch or specialization. The employee id and the employeeSpecializationID are what the schedule and appointment tools take.

branchIds.description: Only these branches (specialists with a schedule there) (UUIDs).

tools.name: medmis_list_employee_services
tools.description: List the services one specialist can provide, after service categories, individual settings and exclusions are applied.

tools.name: medmis_get_schedule_grid
tools.description: Working schedule of specialists for one or more branches and a date range: per specialist and day the schedule id, working hours and slots, optionally only the free ones. Use it to find a free slot before booking. Needs at least one branch and both dates.

branchIds.description: Branch UUIDs, at least one (from medmis_list_branches).

onlyFreeSlots.description: true returns only free slots (default false).

tools.name: medmis_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments (записи на приём) with filters: period, branches, patients, specialists, specializations, statuses, types, tags, creation or change time. Returns id, schedule, times (UTC and local), status, patient, specialist, source, visit type, cabinet and tags.

statusIds.description: Only these status ids (from medmis_list_appointment_reference with dictionary=statuses).

tags.description: Only appointments carrying all of these tags.

tools.name: medmis_get_appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by id: schedule, start and end (UTC and local), status, patient, specialist and specialization, source, visit type, cabinet, tags, comment and whether a paid invoice exists.

tools.name: medmis_list_appointment_reference
tools.description: Read an appointment reference list: statuses, types (in person, telemedicine), visitations (first or repeat visit), sources (how the booking came in) or tags. Returns id/name pairs to read or filter appointments.

tools.name: medmis_list_patients
tools.description: Search patients with filters: name parts (partial match), e-mail or mobile phone (exact), outpatient card number, birth date or age range, sex, tags, acquisition source, creation date and marketing consents. Returns contact data, card number, balances and flags; identity document numbers, INN and SNILS are left out of the list (use medmis_get_patient for one patient).

mobilephone.description: Mobile phone, exact match as stored (e.g. 79161234567).

tools.name: medmis_get_patient
tools.description: Get one patient's full record by id: name, birth date and age, contacts, sex, tags, card and contract numbers, identity document, address, branch, consents, debtor and minor flags, and account balances. Contains personal and health-related data; show only what the user needs.

patientId.description: Patient UUID from medmis_list_patients or an appointment.

tools.name: medmis_list_patient_reference
tools.description: Read a patient reference list: tags, attractions (acquisition sources) or identity_doc_types (identity document types). Returns id/name pairs.

tools.name: medmis_list_invoices
tools.description: List patient invoices (счета) with filters: period, branches, patients, appointments, paid or not, deleted, change time. Returns id, number, date, amount, patient, appointment, payment and notes.

isPaid.description: true paid only, false unpaid only.

isDeleted.description: true deleted only, false active only; omit for both.

tools.name: medmis_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one patient invoice by its numeric id: number, date, amount, duration, patient, appointment, payment and notes.

tools.name: medmis_list_invoice_services
tools.description: List the lines (services and goods) of one invoice with quantities, prices and discounts.

tools.name: medmis_list_payments
tools.description: List payments with filters: period, branches, patients, payment type (1 standard payment, 2 prepared partial refund, 3 completed partial refund, 7 auto-deleted), fiscalised or not, deleted, change time. Returns amounts by method (cash, card, bonus points, insurance, company), cash desk, fiscal flag and patient.

typeIds.description: Payment types: 1 standard, 2 partial refund prepared, 3 partial refund completed, 7 auto-deleted.

isFiscaled.description: true fiscalised only, false not fiscalised.

isDeleted.description: true deleted only, false active only; omit for both.

tools.name: medmis_get_payment
tools.description: Get one payment by id with its amounts per payment method, cash desk, fiscal flag, notes and patient.

tools.name: medmis_list_service_categories
tools.description: List the price list's service categories, optionally below a parent category, by name or for one branch.

parentId.description: Parent category UUID; omit for all.

tools.name: medmis_list_services
tools.description: Search the price list's services (услуги): code, PMU code, name, type (0 service, 1 goods, 2 lab test), category and price.

codePMU.description: PMU code (Russian medical services nomenclature), exact.

tools.name: medmis_list_reserves
tools.description: List reserves (time held in a specialist's schedule for a person, with name and phone) with filters: period, branches, specialists, patients, tags, creation time.

tools.name: medmis_get_reserve
tools.description: Get one reserve by id: a time held in a specialist's schedule for a person, with branch, specialist, date and time, the person's name and phone, comment, tags and auto-extension settings.

tools.name: medmis_list_stores
tools.description: List the stores (warehouses) of one branch. The id is the storeId for medmis_get_stock_levels.

tools.name: medmis_list_store_materials
tools.description: Search the store nomenclature (materials, medicines, consumables) by name or code; isSection separates folders from items.

search.description: Text matched against name and code.

isSection.description: true folders only, false materials only; omit for both.

tools.name: medmis_get_stock_levels
tools.description: Stock on hand of materials per store, optionally for one store or one material.

tools.name: medmis_list_material_series
tools.description: List batches (series) of store materials with expiry, optionally only expired ones or for one material.

tools.name: medmis_list_tasks
tools.description: List internal to-do tasks with filters: author, performer, responsible user, patient, status (0 to do, 2 in progress, 4 paused, 6 done), priority (0 high, 2 medium, 4 low), tags and creation, change, start or deadline time.

todoTaskStatusIDs.description: Statuses: 0 to do, 2 in progress, 4 paused, 6 done.

tools.name: medmis_list_checkup_companies
tools.description: List the companies of the occupational medical check-up module (Профосмотры): the employers the clinic examines staff for.

tools.name: medmis_list_checkup_contracts
tools.description: List check-up contracts with filters: company (B2B), patient (B2C), status, branch and creation date.

createdAtAfter.description: Created from this day, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss (time ignored).

createdAtBefore.description: Created up to this day, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss (time ignored).

tools.name: medmis_list_checkup_patients
tools.description: List the people (check-ups) under check-up contracts with filters: contract, patient, status and check-up date.

profexDateAfter.description: Check-up from this day, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss (time ignored).

profexDateBefore.description: Check-up up to this day, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss (time ignored).

tools.name: medmis_create_appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment in a free slot of a specialist's schedule. Take scheduleId and a free slot from medmis_get_schedule_grid and employeeSpecializationID from medmis_list_employees; times are local clinic time HH:mm. Installed switched off; confirm patient, specialist, day and time with the user first.

scheduleId.description: Schedule UUID of the specialist's working day (from medmis_get_schedule_grid).

employeeSpecializationID.description: UUID of the specialist's specialization (from medmis_list_employees).

statusId.description: Status id (dictionary=statuses); omit for the default.

typeId.description: Appointment type id (dictionary=types), e.g. in person or telemedicine.

visitation.description: 0 not set, 1 first visit, 2 repeat visit.

tools.name: medmis_update_appointment
tools.description: Change an existing appointment: status (e.g. cancel or confirm), start and end time in UTC, comment, tags, cabinet, source, type or visit type. Only the fields you pass change. Installed switched off; confirm the change with the user first.

statusSubId.description: Status sub-id, if the status uses one.

visitation.description: 0 not set, 1 first visit, 2 repeat visit.

tools.name: medmis_create_task
tools.description: Create an internal to-do task, optionally linked to a patient, with performers, responsible user, start, deadline, status and priority. Installed switched off.

todoTaskStatusID.description: 0 to do (default), 2 in progress, 4 paused, 6 done.
